Download IMPROVE aerosol monitoring data

Source: R/source-improve.R
download_improve.Rd

Download annual IMPROVE (Interagency Monitoring of Protected Visual Environments) measurement files from the VIEWS/VIBE data export service hosted at CIRA/CSU. Files are downloaded as .txt.zip archives and can be extracted to pipe-delimited .txt files using the shared download workflow.

Usage

download_improve(
  year = c(2018, 2022),
  product = c("raw", "rhr2", "rhr3"),
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  unzip = TRUE,
  remove_zip = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  hash = FALSE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

year

integer(1 or more). One year, two endpoints, or a non-empty vector of years. Every year from the minimum through the maximum is requested, including gaps: c(2018, 2023) requests 2018:2023. Default is c(2018, 2022). Missing and fractional years are rejected. File availability depends on the selected product and provider; local validation does not check product coverage.

product

character(1). Product selector: "raw" (default) for aerosol measurements (IMPAER), "rhr2" for Regional Haze Rule II data (IMPRHR2), or "rhr3" for Regional Haze Rule III data (IMPRHR3).

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty parent directory. Archives are downloaded into zip_files/ and, when unzip = TRUE, extracted into data_files/.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed. Downloaded archives and extracted measurement files can require substantial storage.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE emits a warning and returns a preview of the planned files without downloading archives or extracting their contents. Default is TRUE.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns. No command file is generated. Default is FALSE.

unzip

logical(1). Extract downloaded ZIP archives into data_files/. Default is TRUE; FALSE retains the archives without extracting their contents.

remove_zip

logical(1). Remove downloaded archives and their zip_files/ directory, including remaining contents, after the extraction loop finishes. Default is FALSE. May be TRUE only when unzip = TRUE.

show_progress

logical(1). Show file download progress. Default is TRUE. Other status messages may still be printed when FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return a combined MD5 hash of the files under data_files/ instead of the download summary when download = TRUE. Ignored when download = FALSE. Default is FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per file download request, including the initial attempt. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Non-negative throttling interval in seconds, passed to download_run_method(). Default is 2.

Value

When download = FALSE, an invisible list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files is returned regardless of hash. These describe all planned downloads, including files that already exist locally; n_files is the number of planned URLs.

When download = TRUE, after downloading and optional extraction, hash = FALSE returns the download summary from download_run_method() invisibly, including counts of successful, failed, and skipped files. With hash = TRUE, returns a visible character scalar containing the combined MD5 hash of data_files/.

The download summary always contains success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no files failed, including when every file was skipped.

Details

The selected product determines the filename prefix. For example, product = "raw" and year = 2022 request IMPAER_2022.txt.zip. zip_files/ and data_files/ are sibling directories created beneath directory_to_save, including when unzip = FALSE or download = FALSE.

Preview mode creates the output directories and makes no network requests. Individual download failures are recorded by download_run_method() during file transfers.

All archives share data_files/ as their extraction destination. Names and paths stored inside each archive are preserved. Pass the directory containing the extracted PREFIX_YYYY.txt files, normally data_files/, as path to process_improve().

download_run_method() skips existing non-empty archives in zip_files/. Those archives are still passed to extraction when unzip = TRUE. Existing extracted .txt files alone do not cause a download to be skipped.

Hashing covers all files recursively under data_files/, including existing files, and excludes archives in zip_files/. With unzip = FALSE, hashing still uses data_files/, which may be empty or contain previously extracted data.

Note

IMPROVE data does not require authentication. Annual downloads contain measurement files; site metadata is resolved separately by process_improve().

See also

download_setup_dir(), download_unzip(), process_improve()

Author

Insang Song, Mitchell Manware

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_improve(
  year = 2022,
  product = "raw",
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "improve"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE
)
} # }
